title: Code and data for "Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Differential and Partial Differential Inclusions"

creators.name: Filipkovska, Maria
creators.affiliation: B. Verkin Institute for Low Temperature Physics and Engineering of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine

description:
Code, configurations, trained network checkpoints, and computational results supporting the numerical experiments (Section 6) of the manuscript "Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Differential and Partial Differential Inclusions".

DR-PINNs replace the classical pointwise PDE/ODE residual by the squared distance from the differential operator to a set-valued admissible set. The archive contains the complete replication pipeline for the three benchmarks of the paper: a linear control-constrained differential inclusion (Section 6.1), a differential inclusion with a time-dependent elliptical admissible set (Section 6.2), and a parabolic partial differential inclusion with a relay nonlinearity trained against an epsilon-banded relaxation (Section 6.3), including the reference solver with its grid and time-step refinement study, the multi-seed and sampling-ablation grid, all random seeds and hyperparameters, run manifests, and the saved checkpoints underlying the reported figures and tables.

Training is decoupled from post-processing: bash reproduce_all.sh reruns the full pipeline, bash reproduce_all.sh --smoke runs a fast end-to-end test, and figures and tables are regenerated from the saved checkpoints in minutes without retraining. See README.md for the directory layout, the staged per-experiment commands, and hardware notes.
notes: This work is based upon work from COST Action InterCoML, CA24136, supported by COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology).
